niche: posting a national screening agency's one mobile screening unit to one of eight flagged airports for the summer, judged by the passengers it moves within the 20-minute queue standard, when host airports stand down their own lanes while the unit is there
answer: Post the mobile screening unit to Eskerford from 15 June to 31 August 2027: it moves 342,200 passengers within the 20-minute standard, against 272,600 at Halloran Bay, and 13 per cent is the smallest whole per cent shortfall in Eskerford's forecast passengers at which another posting would move more.
stakeholder_role: head of screening operations at a national aviation security agency, who posts the agency's one mobile screening team for the summer peak

spine.entity: one screening lane in one 15-minute interval at one central checkpoint, summer 2026, with people through its divest point (passenger lanes, the mobile unit's positions, two staff and aircrew lanes)
spine.source: synthetic (fictional national screening agency's lane sensors)

world.geography: fictional country (Kestland), North Atlantic island republic, English-speaking
world.org_type: national aviation security agency that screens passengers at ten airports and keeps one mobile screening unit

driver: The decisive quantity is what a shared resource adds to a site, and both arms of that difference are taken from the site's own filed plan when the site's records show it never meets the plan: the untreated arm has to be read from what the site does on its own, and the shortfall its treated periods show against the plan has to be split into the part the resource caused and the part that was there anyway, so subtracting the whole shortfall while keeping the plan as the untreated arm, the obvious correction, ranks the sites wrongly too.
driver_concrete: Seven of the eight checkpoints open fewer lanes at their banks than their roster pattern plans, every day of the summer and whether or not the mobile unit is there (Eskerford two fewer), and on posted days their duty managers stand down more on top; run on the 2027 design days, the planning standard's passengers moved within 20 minutes follow the lanes open, so the posting is worth most at Eskerford (342,200 against Halloran Bay's 272,600), while taking the pattern as the lanes open on both arms names Cullinvale (697,500) and taking it on the untreated arm alone names Halloran Bay (272,600 against Eskerford's 208,700).
stump: A competent solver runs the planning standard on each airport's 2027 design days and summer roster pattern with the unit's three lanes added and posts the unit to Cullinvale (697,500 passengers moved within the standard); the step that lands it there is taking the roster pattern as the lanes that will be open on both arms of the comparison, when the checkpoints' own lane counts show seven of the eight opening fewer lanes at their banks than the pattern plans on every day of the summer, Eskerford two fewer, so the posting moves the most at Eskerford (342,200).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the planning standard, the summer 2027 design days and roster patterns, the lane feed and the postings file correctly adds the unit's three lanes to each airport's roster pattern, runs the standard and posts the unit to Cullinvale, 697,500 passengers moved; wrong, because no checkpoint but Halloran Bay opens the lanes its pattern plans at its banks, on its own days or its posted days, so the pattern is the wrong record on both arms.
domain_test: The deciding analysis is checkpoint capacity planning: a fluid queue on 15-minute arrivals against the lanes actually open, scored against the 20-minute wait standard, with both arms of the comparison, the lanes open without the posting and with it, built from the checkpoint's own lane counts rather than from its roster pattern; with another field's nouns there is no lane, no bank of departures, no queue carried from one 15 minutes to the next and no roster pattern the establishment staffs and the shift does not, so the untreated arm has nothing to be read off and the task stops making sense.
notes: Seed AD07's own mechanism (the team opens lanes only where a lane position stands idle, a per-airport cap that re-places the pick) is the dead F3 shape (58 v3 and v4) and its pick-one shape 01 is banned against task181 and task183; the decision and quantity are kept, the pitfall is re-found as interference: the host's response to the posting. Shape 13 (each airport's posting a scenario, the flip the host release at peak that would move the call) because 07 and 01 are banned against task180 and task181.
